adjudication.rationale: The migration `CreateEmbeddableHosts` copies legacy `site_settings.embeddable_hosts` lines directly into the `embeddable_hosts.host` column via raw SQL (e.g. `INSERT ... VALUES ('#{h}', ...)`) and does not run the model’s `before_validation` normalization that strips protocol/paths (`EmbeddableHost` does `sub!(/^https?:\/\//, '')` and `sub!(/\/.*$/, '')`). Since runtime lookup uses `URI(host).host` and then exact-match `where("lower(host) = ?", host)`, any migrated rows stored as `http://discourse.org` or `https://example.com/1234` will never match `discourse.org` / `example.com` and embedding authorization can fail after upgrade. Additionally, `val.split("\n")` can yield empty strings for blank lines, which will be inserted despite the model format validation (bypassed by raw SQL). The migration then deletes the legacy `site_settings` rows (`DELETE ... IN ('embeddable_hosts','embed_category')`), so a bad migration loses the admin’s source data.
